problem_summary.cause: Client-side authentication check in +layout.svelte triggers unnecessary /api/auth/me call
problem_summary.impact: Admin users cannot perform CRUD operations on articles

solution_approach.description: Remove redundant client-side authentication check in layout since server-side protection is already in place

justification.point: Server-side authentication in hooks.server.ts and +layout.server.ts is sufficient
Client-side checkAuth() call causes unnecessary 401 errors
Authentication state is already populated from server-side

task.name: Check current authentication flow
task.description: Verify how authentication is currently handled in +layout.svelte

task.name: Fix client-side authentication
task.description: Modify +layout.svelte to avoid redundant auth checks when user is already authenticated server-side

changes.change: Check if user data exists from server before calling checkAuth()
Only call checkAuth() if no user data is available

task.name: Verify API configuration
task.description: Ensure API client is properly configured with credentials

task.name: Test the fix
task.description: Verify that articles page works correctly after the fix

task.name: Add fallback error handling
task.description: Ensure articles page handles auth errors gracefully

changes.change: Check user permissions before making API calls

expected_outcome.point: No 401 errors on articles page load
Admin users can perform all CRUD operations
